title: Plum Chili Chutney
ingredients: 1   hot chilli, deseeded and chopped very finely
30g   fresh root ginger, peeled and grated
2   large cloves garlic, peeled and crushed with 1 rounded teaspoon salt in a pestle and mortar
1   Spanish onions, peeled and finely chopped
method: De-stone the plums and chop in a food processor so the skins are too small to notice
Put all the ingredients in a pan and simmer until you have a sticky syrup.
details: Category:  Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
